messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point
function.description: Calculate the boiling point of a given substance at a specific pressure. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which to calculate the boiling point.

message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** (about 0.1 atm), the freezing/melting point of pure water drops to roughly **–2 °C**.  

This is because the solid–liquid equilibrium line on the water phase diagram slopes downward with decreasing pressure; at 10 kPa the temperature where ice melts into liquid water is about two degrees below zero.

The freezing point of water at 10 kPa is about -2°C. Let me check: The melting point of ice decreases with decreasing pressure. At 0.1 atm (10 kPa), the melting point is about -2°C.
